response.overview: Lucía, Juana, and Evaristo work in a city that functions like an open-air factory. Meanwhile, Sami and Claudio work aboard an Argentine space capsule. Following the recent arrival of new owners in the country, Lucía confronts this new order by painting counter-advertisements on city walls. At the same time, Sami tries to return to Earth by any means necessary, after being informed that no one will be coming to look for them.
response.title: O
